reason: Candidate A provides a more direct mechanistic focus on harnessing Cu-rich precipitates to impede dislocation motion in FeNiCrCoCu at high temperature, with a clear baseline (as-deposited vs. pre-annealed) and concrete metrics for falsification. This approach is physically sound, addresses the stated limitation, and constitutes a distinct extension of prior understanding of precipitation effects in high-entropy alloy coatings.
